Anya (pm): follow-up from triage  need a concise decision record for legal-hold semantics and default retention. can we agree on defaults and a path for exceptions?

Sofia (security): security stance: legal-hold must override automated deletions and be immutable until an approved lift. every hold action needs auditor-visible justification + actor.

Mia (legal): we need an approval trace: who authorized the hold lift, timestamp, and linked case id. also require exportable chain-of-custody for auditors.

Mark (eng-infra): infra requirements: implement a boolean flag "legal_hold" on tenant metadata, immutable writes via append-only changelog. retention worker checks flag atomically before deletion. prefer per-tenant bucket for evidence.

Li (eng-runtime): runtime impact: when legal-hold is active, long-term KV/cache writes still allowed, but retention sweeper must skip. note: we should cap number of concurrent holds per org to avoid storage explosion.

Rachel (cs): customer impact: customers will expect UI to place hold, and email notification to admins. ops needs playbook for emergency holds. I'll draft templates.

Anya (pm): proposed defaults: standard retention = 90 days, enterprise = 365 days, gov = configurable (contract). legal-hold = indefinite until approved lift. exceptions allowed with documented SLA/contract.

Sofia (security): add: any export performed while on legal-hold must include hold metadata and signed manifest. also record proof-of-possession for BYOK events linked to hold periods.

Mark (eng-infra): operational note: implement export job API that streams to presigned URL; retention sweeper queries changelog for holds and emits metric: hold_count_by_tenant.

Li (eng-runtime): add header `X-Retention-State: normal|hold|archived` to requests so telemetry can filter. also we'll surface metric: bytes_under_hold to billing team.

Mia (legal): require retention policy change audit with actor, reason, and approval ticket id. and require legal-hold lift to include signed approval from legal team.

Anya (pm): decision draft: adopt proposed defaults, implement immutable legal-hold flag, include UI + notification, and require approval trace to lift. exceptions through contract. owners: Mark infra, Li runtime, Sofia security, Rachel CS, Mia legal.

Rachel (cs): I'll schedule two customer calls to validate messaging and surface any special archive needs.

Sofia (security): risk: some HSMs don't provide rotation metadata; manifest schema should tolerate optional fields and include normalization rules.

Mark (eng-infra): action items: changelog implementation, export job API, per-tenant bucket config, sweeper skip logic.

Li (eng-runtime): action items: add header, metric, and ensure inference not blocked by hold state.

DeployBot: CI pipeline: feature/legal-hold -> staging at 2024-10-18T01:00Z :rocket:

Anya (pm): timeline: implement PoC for changelog + UI by next Wed, sign-off Fri. I'll update the roadmap ticket. please react with :thumbsup: when done.
